description: List coordination-cycle roots in the organization (protocol v0.2, GET /coord/cycles): root id, title, status, task_type, project, build_ref, deploy_id and the T2 review id, newest first. Filter by project_id and/or status. Read tier — a reviewer's read-only key can call this too. Follow up with tascan_get_cycle_report root_id=... for the full audit trail of any row.

project_id.description: Optional project UUID to filter to one project's cycles.

status.description: Optional cycle status to filter on (e.g. active, parked, authorized, integrated) — lowercase letters and underscores only, 1-20 chars.

name: tascan_list_cycles
